The Woods Are Lovely, Dark, and Deep

Short Duration Programmes

IIM Bangalore conducts Short Duration Executive Education programmes on various topics such as strategy, leadership, functional skills, HR, technology, analytics, operations, and innovation having a typical duration of 3-6 days.  They are suited to working executives who wish to acquire skills and knowledge in specific areas.

Learn More
Long Duration Programmes

IIM Bangalore conducts Long Duration Executive Education programmes on topics such as General Management, Sectoral programmes for IT, Healthcare, Aerospace and Aviation, Media and Entertainment, Public Policy, Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, etc., with durations that exceed 15 days.

Learn More
Custom Programmes

Custom Executive Education Programmes offered by IIM Bangalore are tailored to the requirements of a client. IIMB works with customers such as Corporates, Government, International organizations, and Institutions. Short or Long Duration programmes with options of  in-campus, MOOCs, and hybrid delivery are available to customers.

Learn More

IIMB EEP Alumni Benefits & Privileges
Group Health Insurance Policy

Ae exclusive and unique top-up group health insurance policy was rolled out in 2023 to IIMB alumni and their families (including parents and parents-in-law) which was a great success. The next window to enrol would open in 2024.

IIMB Alumni Club @Taj West End

An exclusive IIMB Alumni Club opened at the Taj West End (5-Star property), Bengaluru in May 2023. This is an exclusive 20,000 sq. ft. space designed and built by IIMB Alumni. Only B-School in India to have an Alumni Club. 

Alumni Events

The alumni office, IIMB alumni association, and the EEP office organize regular events for alumni across the world. Alumni can attend any of these events. IIMBue, a flagship business conclave event has been attracting thousands of alums and celebrities every year.

About Our EEP Alumni
A vibrant community of alumni

Executive Education Programme Alumni from IIMB have been charting out new pathways in their professional and entrepreneurial lives. Join the vibrant community of 14,000+ alums and enjoy the benefits of being an EEP alumni.
